Now let me look at how the CPU model is used in the x86 init and how cpuid is set. Let me look at the x86_uc_init function:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "x86_uc_init\|cpu_model" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unicorn/qemu/target/i386/unicorn.c 2>/dev/null || find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unicorn -name "*.c" | xargs grep -ln "x86_uc_init"</｜｜DSML｜｜>
